org.antlr:ST4: 3-clause BSD, not 4-clause: the SBOM's 'The BSD License' was read as BSD-4-Clause. Upstream LICENSE.txt (antlr/stringtemplate4) has the three clauses and no advertising clause. Checked by the lead, 2026-09-29 (docs/10 §12.6).
